title: Laughing Dog
blurb: A dog that has, against all reasonable expectation, learned mockery. The wheezy canine cackle became the internet's designated point-and-laugh sound, playing over fails, bad takes, and hubris meeting its scheduled consequences. Being laughed at by a dog is somehow considerably more humbling than being laughed at by a person — there is no reasoning with it, no shared context to appeal to, just an animal that has clearly understood the situation. Nelson Muntz energy delivered in a golden retriever body, which is arguably worse for everybody involved.
origin: A viral clip of a dog appearing to laugh, used to mock fails.
